messages:
kayla: Heads-up — since 03:10 UTC I'm seeing sustained P99 latency regressions on eu-west GPU fleet. Correlates with a steady stream of 'max_batch_full' events and a growing prefill queue. Screenshot of dashboard in thread (link).

tom: yep noticed it too. p50 ~85ms, p95 ~160ms, p99 jumping from ~220ms -> ~470ms in bursts. admission metrics show repeated 'max_batch_reached' spikes every ~30s.

cheng: digging in packer logs now. Pack window still 6ms, max_batch_size configured to 128 on that pool, but admission is capping at 96 because of headroom_policy. When many mid-length seqs land we see pack fragmentation + long head-of-line wait for the batch to fill. That's the tail.

lina: interesting — are these mostly short-chat requests or long-completions? sequence_length histogram?

tom: mostly mixed. 60% short (<64 tokens), 30% medium (64-512), 10% long. But traffic shape shifted — more short concurrent requests from a demo customer. That increases pressure to fill big batches, so short requests end up waiting for large ones to complete.

kayla: recorded a snippet from runtime logs showing admission decisions: 
```
[2025-07-13T03:12:14Z] admission: slot=pool-eu-1 max_batch=128 used=96 waiting=22 reason=max_batch_full
[2025-07-13T03:12:14Z] vmalloc: headroom enforced -> cap=96
[2025-07-13T03:12:15Z] batch_execute: seqLens=[32,512,48,16,256,...] KV-prefill=true prefill_ms=140
```

dmitri: that prefill_ms=140 is the killer. We're hitting prefill on lots of batches because of long seq items in the mix; then smaller requests stuck behind the prefill KV load.

cheng: theory: static max_batch + static headroom isn't matching the new mixed workload. We should try either reducing max_batch for that pool or enabling dynamic_max_batch based on recent seq_len quantiles. Also consider per-request priority for short requests so they don't block.

sre-bot: ALERT: fleet.admission.max_batch_full rate x5 over baseline (1m avg) — alert muted by kayla at 03:15 UTC

lina: can we quick experiment with lowering max_batch to 64 in eu-west-canary? That should reduce pack wait time and lower prefill contention, at the cost of throughput.

tom: +1 for canary. Also suggest enabling fast-path for small seqs: packer rule to prefer filling small buckets first and carve out mini-batches for them.

kayla: spun up a canary change: 
```yaml
pool: eu-west-1a
max_batch_size: 64
headroom_policy: dynamic
pack_window_ms: 4
prefill_limit_ms: 80
```
Applied at 03:20 UTC to 5 nodes (canary).

cheng: observing canary metrics now — initial p99 dropped from ~480ms -> ~200ms for canary nodes within 2 minutes. Non-canary still elevated. Rolling canary to 20 nodes.

dmitri: cost note — reducing max_batch increases per-token cost ~4-7% in our sims. We should balance SLO compliance vs unit cost for eu customers. Logged in infra-cost board.

lina: action items: 1) roll canary to 30% if p99 stays <250ms (lina), 2) enable packer small-request fast-path in next deploy (cheng), 3) evaluate dynamic_max_batch prototype in staging (tom), 4) add short-request priority header for demo customer (kayla).

tom: also flagging network jitter — I see occasional 50-80ms RTT spikes between control-plane and nodes at same AZ coincident with some batch slowness. Could amplify head-of-line. SRE to correlate.

kayla: good catch. @dmitri can you pull the control-plane RTTS for the last 30m?

dmitri: pulling now, will paste a small chart shortly.

sre-bot: INCIDENT-TRACK: 2025-07-13 | eu-west batch head-of-line SLO misses | severity=P2 | linked alerts: fleet.admission.max_batch_full, runtime.prefill.latency

cheng: TL;DR: root causes likely (1) static max_batch/headroom mismatch for mixed short+long workload, (2) KV prefill contention, (3) occasional control-plane RTT jitter. Short term: reduce max_batch and enable small-request fast-path. Medium term: dynamic max_batch + admission weighting + per-request priority.

lina: I'll follow up with a short postmortem template once we stabilize. For now we keep the canary roll and monitor. :thumbsup:

kayla: thanks all — I'll update the incident ticket and close the loop once canary hits 30% and p99 holds.
